rule Suspicious_Rundll32_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1059.003"
        maltype = "TROJAN"
    strings:
        $s1 = "rundll32.exe" nocase
        $s2 = "\\Temp\\" nocase
        $s3 = "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" nocase
        $s4 = "\\Users\\Public\\" nocase
    condition:
        $s1 and ($s2 or $s3 or $s4)
}
